directive_events.owner_directive: Also fix the macOS desktop menu bar tray icon missing after selecting and starting a backend; determine whether development mode differs.
directive_events.reason: Owner adds macOS desktop tray visibility after backend selection

directive_events.owner_directive: Tray issue resolved by owner: too many menu-bar items pushed the icon out of sight. Continue MiniApp work.
directive_events.reason: Owner located the menu-bar icon hidden by other tray items; no desktop fix required

directive_events.owner_directive: Fix the ADR-054 Phase D audit bugs and prepare the desktop for owner testing
directive_events.reason: Complete audit regression evidence and record protected comment-only review intent for the eventual PR

directive_events.owner_directive: The AI-host sidebar adaptation seems to have affected desktop: its sidebar opens too narrow. Fix this too.
directive_events.reason: Owner reports desktop sidebar reopens too narrow; isolate preferred expansion widths by presentation

directive_events.owner_directive: Do not display MiB or process memory usage to MiniApp users; keep usable process state and controls. Implementation is handed off exclusively to finish_guided_miniapp in the existing dedicated worktree.
directive_events.reason: Owner requested removing technical memory metrics from the normal MiniApp interface and delegated implementation to a subagent.

directive_events.owner_directive: Change the MiniApps sidebar action to plus icon and New. Diagnose and fix old project outputs remaining in the new project chooser, verify backend source/context ownership, reject previous-project source references after switching to an empty project, and distinguish choices by node instance or display name.
directive_events.reason: Owner reproduced previous-project outputs in a new project MiniApp chooser and requested project isolation plus clearer creation UI.

directive_events.owner_directive: Keep the plus icon and New text as one non-wrapping button at the minimum desktop sidebar width.
directive_events.reason: Owner observed the plus and New label wrapping in the live sidebar.

directive_events.owner_directive: Open a MiniApp with a single click. Avoid duplicate activation and preserve independent popover actions.
directive_events.reason: Owner changed MiniApp catalogue activation from double-click to single-click.

directive_events.owner_directive: Use Data source with Select an output from a completed block. Use Instructions with Describe what to display and which controls you need. Placeholder: Show the image with a threshold slider. Update the mask as I adjust the threshold. Keep backend description storage unchanged.
directive_events.reason: Owner approved concise copy supplied by the primary agent.

directive_events.owner_directive: Add rotation-arrow plus Restart, square-stop plus Stop, and blocks icon plus Convert using the existing icon library. Keep the full Convert to interactive block tooltip and accessible name, retain visible short text and neutral button styling.
directive_events.reason: Owner requested icon-labelled MiniApp controls and a shorter Convert label.

directive_events.owner_directive: Simplify ConvertToBlockDialog to Create block with From and MiniApp display name, Outputs rows with persistent Name and Data type labels, catalogue-constrained type selection, generated unique legal ports without a Port input, plus Add output, optional Instructions with placeholder Use the current threshold as the default., and Create block submit. Keep Provider and Permission mode components, layout, copy and behavior unchanged; do not infer output defaults.
directive_events.reason: Owner approved a simpler conversion form while explicitly preserving provider and permission controls.

directive_events.owner_directive: Withdraw Create block title and submission wording. Retain approved simplified output fields and preserve Provider/Permission mode. Restore previous conversion wording until the owner confirms replacement copy; do not invent explanatory prose.
directive_events.reason: Owner rejected Create block wording; primary agent is discussing explanatory conversion copy.

directive_events.owner_directive: Use title Convert to interactive block. Explain: Use {MiniApp display name} as an interactive step in your workflow. Choose which results it should send to the next blocks. Bold the dynamic display name. Add Your MiniApp will remain available. Submit label Convert. Retain simplified fields and unchanged Provider/Permission components and behavior.
directive_events.reason: Owner approved the final explanatory conversion copy.

directive_events.owner_directive: Start the MiniApp skill over: explain what/when, composition/runtime/components, faithful data presentation, colorful usable interaction, and fast meaningful self-testing. Draft it for review.
directive_events.reason: Owner-directed rewrite of the MiniApp authoring skill draft for joint review

directive_events.owner_directive: The MiniApp skill should give AI clear ordered working steps: first do X, second Y, third Z.
directive_events.reason: Restructure the owner-reviewed MiniApp skill draft into an explicit execution sequence

directive_events.owner_directive: Remove temporary missing-tool caveats from the production skill. Delegate implementation of AI GUI screenshot tooling and make all existing core previewers reusable by AI-written MiniApps. Keep verification quick and effective.
directive_events.reason: Owner requires production MiniApp skill and authorizes implementation of GUI screenshot tooling and reusable core previewers

directive_events.owner_directive: Extract existing core previewer data display UI into prebuilt components that MiniApps can import, compose, supply data to, and control; this is not invoking the previewer service or embedding a complete previewer page.
directive_events.reason: Clarify reusable viewer UI components rather than previewer invocation

directive_events.owner_directive: Apply the New MiniApp source label disambiguation to the Open on which data picker so repeated load_data outputs can be distinguished.
directive_events.reason: Disambiguate same-name block outputs when opening an existing MiniApp

directive_events.owner_directive: Replace top-right Cancel text with an X icon in all dialogs introduced in this phase, including New MiniApp.
directive_events.reason: Use icon-only top-right close buttons throughout Phase D dialogs

directive_events.owner_directive: MiniApps should import prebuilt UI components extracted from all core previewers and compose them with their own data and interactions.
directive_events.reason: Document the implemented reusable renderer component contract in the MiniApp authoring skill

directive_events.owner_directive: Extract the UI from all existing core previewers into prebuilt components MiniApps can import and control; reuse those same components in core preview pages.
directive_events.reason: Integrate reusable core renderer UI components from the dedicated agent worktree

directive_events.owner_directive: After all ongoing changes are complete, push the branch and create a PR. Complete local validation and monitor CI; do not merge.
directive_events.reason: Owner authorizes final integration, push and one PR after ongoing work is complete

directive_events.owner_directive: Finish all changes, validate the integrated branch against current main, and submit one PR.
directive_events.reason: Prepare final PR against current main and retain upstream fixes

directive_events.owner_directive: Finish all ongoing MiniApp work, validate it together, and submit one PR.
directive_events.reason: Prepare release notes and integrated guided-session readiness record for final PR

directive_events.owner_directive: Complete production MiniApp skills and required documentation before submitting the combined PR; the UI must not show process memory figures.
directive_events.reason: Close documentation audit findings affecting MiniApp conversion and memory presentation

directive_events.owner_directive: Remove the block right-click menu, move MiniApp creation/opening into an interactive hover detail window, keep it open while hovered, and add an entry opening the block source editor.
directive_events.reason: Integrate owner-requested persistent canvas hover actions and block source editor entry

directive_events.owner_directive: Investigate all ADR-054 documentation, AI skills and user guides and include the required completed work in the final PR.
directive_events.reason: Integrate the requested ADR-054 documentation coverage audit as PR evidence

directive_events.owner_directive: Provide screenshot_gui only. Teach MiniApp authors to use their available computer use tools for interactions and report any unverified behavior accurately.
directive_events.reason: Owner selected screenshots plus existing agent computer use instead of additional MiniApp interaction MCP tools

directive_events.owner_directive: Complete the changes, push them and open the final PR; do not merge.
directive_events.reason: Use one final integration branch with unambiguous active ledger while preserving original Phase D provenance

directive_events.owner_directive: Fetch and integrate the latest remote main, including existing CI timeout and runtime fixes; do not separately change gate timeout policy without authorization.
directive_events.reason: Owner requested verification and synchronization with latest remote main before any timeout-policy change

directive_events.owner_directive: Apply the supplied skill diff, then directly open the PR. Do not run local full tests. Use the supported PR-wrapper preflight skip if existing incomplete test evidence prevents submission; do not bypass CI or claim validation passed.
directive_events.reason: Owner supplied final MiniApp skill wording and directed immediate PR submission without further local full-suite runs; retain CI and disclose incomplete local validation.

directive_events.owner_directive: Fix Codex PR audit findings. Add Reload for the whole MiniApps registration list in the left sidebar, not the MiniApp page. Continue focused validation only; no local full suites.
directive_events.reason: Owner requested Codex audit fixes and clarified Reload means refreshing the MiniApps registered catalogue in the left sidebar, consistent with other palettes.

directive_events.owner_directive: Also fix the CI Python test failures.
directive_events.reason: CI Python 3.11 and 3.13 both fail the published user-guide sidebar expectation because the new MiniApps guide is missing from its fixture.

docs_events.rationale: Audit fixes restore the accepted miniapp design.
Existing source selection workflow is unchanged; this corrects ambiguous node labels to match the create dialog.
